content.short: Bitso is Latin America's largest crypto platform, with trading, stablecoin yield and cross-border transfers in Mexico, Brazil, Argentina and Colombia.
content.description: Bitso has served Latin American users since 2014. Its app combines 100+ cryptocurrencies with thousands of stocks and ETFs. Users can earn yield on USDC and USDT balances and send money abroad in local currency. Bitso Business handles payment flows and treasury for companies moving funds between the region and the rest of the world. A self-custody perpetuals venue, onchain.cc, is available for more active traders. The redesigned app puts crypto and global stocks in one portfolio, while onchain.cc, operated separately in El Salvador, is open around the clock for traders who want to keep custody.
